fomod.Name: AllTogether SKSE (Skyrim Together Add-ons Bundle 1)
fomod.Author: mailamea10
fomod.Description: Choose any of the four add-ons, then select one STR version and Skyrim runtime. Installs the matching shared launcher and preserves LipSync's secure/open voice relay choice. See the installed Docs for MO2/Vortex setup and requirement download links.
